seo.title: IH-1000 — immunohematology system | LabWell
seo.description: IH-1000 is an automated Bio-Rad immunohematology system with capacity for up to 180 samples. Supply, installation, and maintenance in Ukraine from LabWell.

T2_hero.lead: A Bio-Rad system for ID-Card testing, designed for high capacity and continuous access during operation.

T3_about.h2: What IH-1000 is and who it is for
T3_about.text: IH-1000 is a fully automated Bio-Rad system for immunohematology testing with ID-Cards. It is designed for laboratories that need high capacity for samples, cards, and reagents while retaining continuous access during operation. Materials can be loaded during processing, and STAT samples can be handled as a priority.

items.text: Samples and reagents can be loaded during processing. Two independent pipetting arms, three centrifuges, and a separate ID-Card transport arm support parallel operations.
The system handles STAT samples immediately. According to the manufacturer, it is also optimized for small blood volumes, including pediatric samples.

rows.name: BRiCare, Remote Service and Support Software

T6_items.footnote: Ask a LabWell manager to confirm the configuration.

items.q: What tests is IH-1000 designed for?
items.a: It is designed for automated immunohematology testing with ID-Cards.

items.q: What is the capacity of IH-1000?
items.a: The system holds up to 180 samples, 240 ID-Cards, and 28 reagent vials.

items.q: Can IH-1000 handle small blood volumes?
items.a: Yes. According to the manufacturer, the system is optimized for small volumes, including pediatric samples.

items.q: Who supplies and maintains IH-1000 in Ukraine?
items.a: LabWell is an official Bio-Rad distributor in Ukraine. It helps select the most effective solution for your needs and provides supply, installation, staff training, warranty and post-warranty maintenance, and application support.

T12_contact.text: Tell us about your test menu and sample workload, and we will help assess whether IH-1000 fits your laboratory.
